title: Add Notion Recipe via Audio Upload
hard_category_focus: Notion-based meal planning and recipe management
breadth_reason: This script extends breadth by combining audio upload ASR with real-time verification of the user's signed-in Notion surface, ensuring the full public product path works end-to-end.

v7_target.engine: user-device engine installed on signed-in user's computer
v7_target.surface_rule: Only Anticipy's installed engine interacting with the user's real signed-in Chrome Notion tab
v7_target.proof_rule: Every action requires fresh surface-readable proof from the public build

primary_user_input.reason: Uploaded audio ASR coverage ensures the transcription is sourced directly from an mp3 file rather than live mic or pasted text, testing the /api/listen/upload pipeline.

real_user_surfaces.name: Notion Recipe Database
real_user_surfaces.surface: Notion open in user's signed-in Chrome with a meal planning database visible
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Visible database containing at least one record, and the user's profile icon confirming signed-in state

real_user_surfaces.name: Chrome Signed-In Profile
real_user_surfaces.surface: User's personal Google account signed into Chrome
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Chrome avatar or account indicator showing the authenticated user

moments.description: Navigate to anticipy.ai/app and sign in, completing onboarding to download the engine.
Verify that Notion is open in a Chrome tab with the meal planning database, and the user is signed into Chrome.

moments.spoken_reference_text: Please add a new record to my Notion Recipes database for the miso eggplant Avery sent me and tag it weeknight. If you cannot prove the visible Notion surface or my signed-in workspace, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: The stranger generates a fresh mp3 audio artifact per run via the 'say' command, then uploads it through /api/listen/upload.

moments.description: After ASR, the engine confirms that the transcribed intent matches the original spoken text and checks if the surface is still valid.

acceptable_outcomes: act: add the record to Notion with the specified content and tag
ask: request clarification if the surface is ambiguous or additional info is needed
decline: refuse if the Notion surface is not verifiable or the user is not signed in

moments.description: Observe that the primary input is uploaded audio and that no secondary input mode (e.g., transcript paste) is offered, confirming the gap.

success_criteria: The engine successfully transcribes the uploaded mp3 audio and extracts the intent to add a Notion record.
The engine verifies the real Notion surface in the user's signed-in Chrome and proceeds to add the record with the specified recipe and tag.
The Notion database shows the new entry with the correct content and 'weeknight' tag.
All proof artifacts (surface screenshot, ASR transcript, engine log) are fresh and tied to the public build.
The entire flow completes without fallback to transcript paste or live mic, validating the audio upload pipeline.
failure_triggers: The uploaded mp3 contains corrupted audio or silence, causing ASR to fail or produce unintelligible text.
The Notion surface is not visible (e.g., tab closed, signed-out state, wrong database), leading to a decline.
The engine fails to write to Notion due to permission issues or network errors, resulting in a decline or ask.
The proof artifacts are stale or originate from a mocked environment, violating the fresh proof rule.
The user's Chrome profile is not signed in, causing the surface precheck to fail and preventing any action.
